diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the model assigned the generator pallet to Truck T-2, which aligns with the fact PF2 (owned by A3). This allowed Check C3 to pass despite the lone decision-maker never having access to PF2. The model likely defaulted to assigning the heaviest pallet to the truck with the highest capacity, which is a common heuristic.

C3.why: The exact 2,500-kilogram limit on Truck T-3 versus the generator pallet's exact 3,200-kilogram weight changes the generator assignment to Truck T-1, leaves the administrative pallet on Truck T-3, and requires a commitment whose detail records T-3's weight limitation.
